contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans, Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, Trier mint; possibly RIC vol. 8 page 151 no. 185. Obverse description: Youthful bust pearl diademed draped and cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: possibly [CONSTAN] S PF AVG. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other holding wreaths aloft; ?leaf between Victories. Reverse inscription: [VICTORI]AE DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: TR[-]. Diameter: 13.8mm, Weight: 1.02gms, die axis: 6
